prakash sanshleshan kya hai: Boss, prakash sanshleshan (photosynthesis) woh prakriya hai jisse paudhe surya ke prakash, pani aur carbon dioxide ki madad se apna bhojan banate hain.
gurutvakarshan kya hai: Boss, gurutvakarshan (gravity) woh aakarshan bal hai jisse do vastuon ke beech khinchav hota hai, jaise dharti ka har cheez ko apni taraf kheench na.
newton ka doosra niyam: Boss, newton ke doosre niyam ke anusaar kisi vastu par lagne wala bal (F) uske dravyaman (m) aur tvaran (a) ke gunanfal ke barabar hota hai: F = m * a.
paani ka rasayanik sutra: Boss, paani ka rasayanik sutra H2O hota hai, jisme hydrogen ke 2 aur oxygen ka 1 parmanu hota hai.
bharat ki rajdhani kya hai: Boss, bharat ki rajdhani nai dilli (New Delhi) hai.
saur mandal mein kitne grah hain: Boss, hamare saur mandal mein kul 8 grah hain: budh, shukra, prithvi, mangal, brihaspati, shani, arun aur varun.
atom kya hota hai: Boss, atom (parmanu) padarth ki woh sabse chhoti ikai hai jisme us tatva ke gun maujood rehte hain.
energy conservation law: Boss, urja sanrakshan ke niyam ke anusaar urja ko na toh banaya ja sakta hai aur na hi nasht, balki ek roop se doosre roop mein badla ja sakta hai.

jod ghatana guna bhag ka niyam:
Boss, jod (+), ghatana (-), guna (x) aur bhag (/) karte waqt BODMAS niyam ka dhyan rakhein:
1. Pehle Bracket (कोष्ठक) hal karein.
2. Phir Order/Power (घात/वर्ग), Division (भाग) aur Multiplication (गुणा).
3. Ant mein Addition (जोड़) aur Subtraction (घटाना).
Vidhi: Har step ko alag line mein hal karein taaki chinha (+ / -) ki galti na ho.
varg aur vargmul kaise nikalte hain:
Boss, kisi sankhya ka varg (square) usko khud se guna karke nikalta hai: n^2 = n * n (jaise 12^2 = 144).
Vargmul (square root, √) woh sankhya hoti hai jiska varg karne par mool sankhya mile (jaise √144 = 12).
Vidhi: Chhoti sankhya ke liye gunankhand (prime factorization) ya pahade dekhein, aur badi sankhya ke liye long division method lagayein.
trikonmiti ke mukhya formule:
Boss, samkon tribhuj (right-angled triangle) mein theta (θ) ke liye mukhya trikonmiti (trigonometry) anupat:
• sin(θ) = Lamb / Karn
• cos(θ) = Aadhar / Karn
• tan(θ) = Lamb / Aadhar = sin(θ) / cos(θ)
• sin^2(θ) + cos^2(θ) = 1
Laganai ki vidhi: Diye gaye kon (θ) ke hisab se Lamb, Aadhar aur Karn pehchanein, phir sahi anupat (sin, cos ya tan) lagayein.
pythagoras pramey kya hai:
Boss, samkon tribhuj mein:
(Karn)^2 = (Lamb)^2 + (Aadhar)^2
Laganai ki vidhi: Do bhujayein pata hon aur teesri nikaalni ho, toh dono ka varg karke formula mein rakhein aur ant mein vargmul (square root) lein.
bijganit ke mukhya sarvasamika formule:
Boss, algebra ke zaroori formule:
• (a + b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2
• (a - b)^2 = a^2 - 2ab + b^2
• a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)
Laganai ki vidhi: Sawal ke roop ko formula ke baayen paksh (LHS) se milayein, 'a' aur 'b' ka man chunein, aur daayen paksh (RHS) mein rakh kar saral karein.
science ke mukhya formule aur lagane ki:
Boss, vigyan ke zaroori formule:
1. Chal (Speed): v = d / t (Doori / Samay)
2. Bal (Force): F = m * a (Dravyaman * Tvaran)
3. Karya (Work): W = F * d * cos(θ)
4. Gati ka pehla samikaran: v = u + a*t
5. Ohm ka niyam: V = I * R
Laganai ki vidhi:
• Pehle sabhi units ko ek hi system (jaise SI unit) mein badlein.
• Jo nikalna hai uska formula likhein.
• Diye gaye man rakh kar ganana karein aur ant mein sahi unit likhein.
